integrity: Proof gives general necessary and sufficient atom count. Standalone finite verifier checks semantic definition independently for small cases; its exhaustivity is not a proof for arbitrary size. Previously known graph edge clique-cover characterization is credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only finite nonempty reflexive symmetric frames; power-set Boolean algebras; unrestricted Boolean-valued parameterized propositional translations; universal valuations on one fixed isomorphic frame. Not a formula-specific countermodel bound, and not a polynomial-time algorithm for edge clique cover. Earlier equivalent private-label graph representation results are a bibliographic residual risk.
title: Optimal Boolean-atom budget for valuation-faithful co-consistency representations
